responsibility: Provides compatibility definitions for a subset of Intel BMI2 intrinsics on powerpc64le-oriented GCC targets. It implements functions such as _bzhi, _mulx, _pdep, and _pext using portable C and PowerPC builtins like popcount, clz, and bpermd, allowing x86 intrinsic-heavy code to be ported while still compiling through the PowerPC header stack via <x86intrin.h>.
